plan.say: I'll combine your screenshots into a light-to-dark phone visual with one image edit. I'll pair it with the post text: “Meet dark mode. A fresh look for late nights and brighter days. Switch to the dark side.”

steps.why: Both visual elements already exist, so one composition edit can preserve the app UI and combine them into the announcement.
